meals.week: Until Jester and Olympia reach Support 3
meals.note: Order Madazins, Goat Roast and Coffee-Berry Paste: each is Perfect for its table.
Ursula and Catania take the first table (Coffee-Berry Paste is Perfect).

weekly.text: Teach Dietrich's Combat Arts to others for Magic Echo Stones: Jester first once he joins
detail: Rogue and Ranger still use swords, so his arts carry.

missables.text: Give Esmeralda a Mature Blush at the Port by 6/15: Catching Sweetie's Eye is Dietrich only
detail: Look for the Mature Blush at the Item Shop, the Marketplace and Vandahl first.

note.text: Catch up on Specialty: anyone who missed Lv 20 or Renown 4 in Ch 6 takes the exam now
detail: Io: [[class:Light Cavalry]] now if his Sword was behind in Ch 6.

buy.text: Buy cavalry-effective weapons for the battle: [[item:Ridersbane]], [[item:Zanbato]], Ji, Halberd

note.text: Leave the [[item:Conflagrant Gem]] in storage: on Mikaela its Hit only repeats Veteran's Mettle
detail: Iron Axe 10 + Gem 5 = Wt 15 gets her doubled. She wears the [[item:Giant's Ring]].

prep.text: Get Jester and Olympia to Support 3 now: recruit both the day Renown 6 lands (late Ch 7 at best)
detail: Renown 6 usually comes in Ch 8: their quest steps are in the Ch 8 Recruits slot.

prep.text: Push Goliath to Support 3: his 3 Giant's Meat is a Ch 8 or 9 job (desert and Lv 35 skirmishes)
Keep Simon, Ursula and Dante at the table: they join at Renown 7, after 9/18, and at Renown 8

route.note: Beat Camilo at [[place:Fort Hayn]] this chapter (Renown 5): the main push toward Renown 6

sub.note: Dietrich only: Mature Blush to Esmeralda at the Port by 6/15
3 Ouranotite from [[place:Cougar Woodlands]]; hand in before the hunt starts on 7/21
detail: Due 7/31, but Ch 8's free time ends 7/21. The [[item:Tempest Bow]] goes to Kiroc.

sub.note: Starts a three-part chain: Another Challenge (Ch 9), One Last Challenge (Ch 10)
Uses the Jyoppa from Defeat Aguino's Thieves
[[place:Fallen General's Barrows]], for the Priest in the Entertainment District
Visit 4 statues by 11/27: Riding, Heavy-Armor and Flying Manuals
detail: Statues: Jurah at [[place:Gaura Grassland]], Kalla at [[place:Utuna Pass]], Fortuna at [[place:Solel's Temple]].
Yu Phas at [[place:Lake Brontes]]: same trip as Attack of the Huge Birds (Ch 10).
Manuals: Heavy-Armor to Goliath (Heavy D), Riding to Io or Ursula, Flying to Catania (Flying D).

explore.text: [[place:Cindered Road Cave]]: Flying Manual (save it for Catania, Renown 8), Concoction
detail: The [[item:Conflagrant Gem]] here has no user on this route.

explore.text: [[place:Cougar Woodlands]]: Ouranotite for Rare Stone Hunting, [[item:Muen]] (spear), 2 Bullion
[[place:Cave Behind the Falls]]: Bullion and [[item:Pure Water]]; skip Archive B (Fabio knows Mire)

battle.title: Qualifier vs. Twin Jewels of Arago

tips.text: Bring cavalry-effective weapons: the map is full of cavalry
Split into teams, with a tank covering each fragile unit
Crates of good weapons appear partway through: grab them
Leave the Bell Tower alone: destroying it brings in a third army of Elephant Riders

exitExtra.text: Jester and Olympia recruited, or at Support 3 and waiting for Renown 6
